name: com.drinksystem
displayName: Drink System - FBT Mayfair Drink Station
description: Networked FBT Mayfair bar drink station for VRChat worlds (PC + Quest), laid out as a clear line: 1 take a glass, 2 place it, 3 pick strength (drunk post-processing) + froth and pour, 4 finish it (straw, fruit, glass tint, logo), 5 drink. Uses your own glasses prefab, lightweight manual sync, glass respawn. One-click builder: Tools > Drink System > Build Drink Machine In Scene.
